NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is automatically updated when semantic release (release.yml) runs. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: Change installer source
patches.description: Makes the app think it was installed from the store you choose, like Google Play.

patches.name: Clone app
patches.description: Lets you install another copy of the app by giving it a different package name. Adds ".morphe" by default; each copy needs its own name. Some apps don't handle cloning well and may crash or behave strangely.

options.title: Package name
options.description: Choose a unique package name for this copy, or leave Default to add .morphe.

options.title: Update permissions
options.description: Renames the app's custom permissions so the copies can be installed together. This can break features in some apps.

options.title: Update providers
options.description: Renames the app's providers so the copies can be installed together. This can break features in some apps.

patches.name: Disable Play Store updates
patches.description: Stops Play Store updates by setting the app's version code to the highest Android allows. Can cause issues in some apps and won't work with root-mounted installs.

patches.name: Disable startup ad campaigns
patches.description: Skips the ad campaigns shown when you open Yanosik, even ones already saved on your phone. Normal startup messages and account checks stay as they are.

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Stops Yanosik's usage analytics, ad statistics and location targeting, Wi-Fi/app scans, ProxiCloud tracking, Notinote sample uploads, Firebase analytics and crash uploads, and Facebook app events. Online navigation and account requests still send the data they need; this isn't an offline mode or a network-wide blocker.

patches.name: Disable voice ads
patches.description: Mutes sponsored voice ads and spoken ad campaigns so they don't interrupt your drive. You still get navigation directions and road warnings, with the same audio controls.

patches.name: Hide banner ads
patches.description: Gets rid of banner ads on the map, during navigation and on the dashboard, including ad placeholders. Keeps road alerts and route controls in place.

patches.name: Override certificate pinning
patches.description: Lets you inspect the app's network traffic through a proxy by bypassing certificate pinning.

patches.name: Override local PRO checks
patches.description: Keeps local PRO mode on and opens up the PRO settings. Hides the Switch to PRO toggle. Purchases and server-side perks aren't changed.

patches.name: Spoof signature
patches.description: Makes the app see the original APK's signature when it checks its own package.

patches.name: Suppress Premium promotions
patches.description: Replaces the home PRO shortcut with your Vibe Patched icon that does nothing when tapped. Hides PRO promo cards and the sidebar upgrade card, and closes the PRO page. Donation and voucher pages stay available.
